operations.name: files.list
operations.description: The workspace tree (the nodes collection) as the explorer shows it: folders first, then A-Z by name, with is_dir, is_markdown and…

folder.description: Folder path to list, e.g. notes; default the top level.

recursive.description: Whole subtree (default true) or only the folder's own items.

operations.name: files.read
operations.description: Open a .md or .markdown file: its text, its modified time (pass it back as expected_modified when writing), and whether the person has it open in a tab.

operations.name: files.write
operations.description: Save new text into an existing .md or .markdown file, as Ctrl+S does in the editor; --append true adds the text to the end instead (no newline is inserted: start the text with one).

content.description: The whole new text ("" empties the file); required

encoding.description: base64 for text that starts with -- (front matter); default text

append.description: Add content to the end instead of replacing (no newline is inserted between; begin content with a newline if needed). Also lets long text be sent in parts.

expected_modified.description: The modified value from files.read; refuses if the file was saved since

operations.name: files.create
operations.description: New empty file (.md is added unless the path ends in .md or .markdown, any case) or new folder, as New File / New Folder; missing parent folders are created.

operations.name: files.upload
operations.description: Add a file with this text at a path, as Upload File / Upload Folder; refuses a path that already exists.

content.description: The file's text ("" for an empty file); required

encoding.description: base64 for text that starts with -- (front matter); default text

operations.name: files.upload-overwrite
operations.description: Upload that replaces an existing file, as Overwrite in the upload conflict dialog.

path.description: File path to create or replace

content.description: The file's text ("" for an empty file); required

encoding.description: base64 for text that starts with -- (front matter); default text

operations.name: files.rename
operations.description: Rename a file or folder in its folder, as the Rename dialog; a folder's contents move with it and their open tabs follow.

operations.name: files.move
operations.description: Move a file into another existing folder, as dragging it onto that folder in the explorer.

operations.name: files.delete
operations.description: Delete a file, or a folder with everything in it; their open tabs close.

operations.name: editor.tabs
operations.description: The files the person has open in editor tabs (the sessions record) and the active one, as last saved by the editor; unsaved edits are not…
